latest.title: The topology of tridiagonal isospectral sets
latest.abstract: We describe the topology of the set of tridiagonal symmetric real matrices with fixed non-simple spectrum. The tridiagonal isospectral set is not a submanifold of the corresponding orthogonal conjugacy class, but a collection of submanifolds which intersect cleanly. We show that the tridiagonal isospectral set is an aspherical space and that its Betti numbers are combinatorial numbers. This generalizes to arbitrary spectrum constructions and results known for simple spectrum. We also extend these results to split real semisimple Lie algebras.
latest.workSummary: 描述重谱三对角实对称矩阵等谱集为干净相交的子流形集合，证明非球面性并计算组合型 Betti 数。
techniques: 分裂实半单 Lie 代数
latest.breakthrough: 将简单谱拓扑结论扩展到任意谱。
latest.limitations: 等谱集不是通常意义下光滑子流形。 研究结论按摘要级分析；未完成正文方法核验。
latest.priorityReason: 谱几何与拓扑交叉，但对曲率研究的直接影响有限。
